product_info.name: Wells Fargo Active Cash Credit Card

terms_analysis.key_information:
Key Points:
• APR ranges from 19.24% to 29.24% for purchases (varies with Prime Rate), which is typical for mainstream credit cards
• No annual fee and 2% cash back on all purchases make this a competitive cashback card
• Pro: No annual fee combined with 2% unlimited cashback beats most no-fee cards that offer 1-1.5%
• Con: Balance transfer fee up to 5% is higher than many competitors who offer 3% or promotional 0% fees
terms_analysis.risks:
Potential Risks:
• [MEDIUM] Mandatory arbitration clause prevents class-action lawsuits and jury trials, very common in credit cards.
  Impact: Must resolve disputes through private arbitration instead of court, potentially limiting your legal options
terms_analysis.consumer_score:
Credit Card Consumer Score: 62/100 (Good)
Interpretation: This is a solid mainstream credit card with fair terms typical of major banks. The no annual fee and 2% cashback make it attractive for everyday spending, though the APR is standard for the industry.
terms_analysis.details:
Details:
• Fees: No annual fee, late payment up to $40, balance transfer up to 5%, cash advance 5% or $10 minimum, foreign transaction 3%
• Interest rates: Purchase APR 19.24%-29.24%, Cash advance APR 29.99%, minimum interest charge $1 if any interest owed
• Repayment: 25-day grace period on purchases, minimum payment is 1% of balance plus interest/fees or $25
• Rewards: 2% cash back on all purchases with no caps or categories
• Cancellation: Either party can close account anytime, you remain liable for outstanding balance
• Dispute resolution: Mandatory binding arbitration for most disputes, small claims court allowed

reddit_insights.positive:
• 2% cash back on all purchases with no annual fee
• $200 welcome bonus and cell phone insurance included
• Easy redemption and potential future travel point transfers
reddit_insights.negative:
• 3% foreign transaction fee makes it less ideal for travel
• Credit limit increases can be difficult to obtain
• Tied to Wells Fargo, which some users view negatively
